rationale: The agent removed the duplicate subscription call in subscribers.ts (the actual defect the old HACK comment named) and replaced the flawed time-window/user+type dedupe heuristic with a correct identity-based (event id) dedupe with a long retention window, which properly handles webhook retries regardless of timing rather than special-casing the ~1-second symptom. The payment.failed opt-out bypass logic is untouched by the diff, so the protected behavior is preserved.
